How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your new floor properly starts with installation: High Five can be installed as a floating floor or glued down, but it cannot be stapled. Note that if you are installing up to a stair nosing, you cannot butt the floor to the nosing—you must staple or glue leading up to it.
